offer.text: A pack of skeletons rattles around the old field, and I'll not waste good arrows on a clumsy shot. Drop eight of them — show me a marksman's work.

accept.text: Loose clean and let none get within a sword's reach.

decline.text: Then I'll thin them myself, slow as that'll be.

in_progress.text: How many of the bone-rattlers have you dropped?

ready.text: Eight clean kills. That is how a bow is meant to sing.

complete.text: You shoot like you were born with a string in hand. Well done.
